propositions: The close path previously held the store write lock across compaction for up to 13m53s, starving concurrent agents, requiring removal of inline compaction (choosy-arthrodic-barbet / change 1702).
Removing inline compaction left stores without local CI and no cron with no standing compaction trigger, causing event logs to grow unbounded unless manually invoked via `rebar compact <id>`.

Compaction selection must honor the foldable horizon (default 30 min), selecting only on tickets with foldable events over threshold or lacking snapshots, to avoid selecting tickets whose excess events are all inside the horizon and would fold nothing.

The sweep must be triggered both by a 6-hourly CI schedule (amortized path where CI exists) and by an operation-linked detached worker after close operations (the floor for stores without CI or cron), without reintroducing the original 13m53s lock hold.

A compactor must hold an advisory stamped lock to prevent concurrent compaction workers from racing, re-probing mid-run to yield to concurrent writers and not stamp the staleness clock when standing aside due to lock contention.

The sweep walk over git history per ticket occurred under the store write lock and recurred per ticket across thousands of tickets (per-ticket scale of the per-event bug 7084), requiring it to be hoisted out of the lock and batched into a single walk per sweep.
